reason: Implementation audit found that the initial local config incorrectly allowed a random exact-hop readout even though KC annotations loaded successfully. The user protocol permits random 1024-node fallback only when annotation fails. This correction is mandatory protocol compliance, not result-conditioned tuning.
old_rule: If requested K has zero KC, choose first positive K in 5..8; if none, use fixed random 1024 nodes from exact hop 2 or 3.
corrected_rule: If requested K and 5..8 have zero annotated KC while annotations loaded, select the hop in {2,3} with the largest positive annotated-KC count (tie: smaller hop). Random 1024-node fallback is legal only if annotation loading fails.

deterministic_resolution.readout: 2544 annotated KCs at exact shortest hop 3

additional_missing_preregistered_measure: The lambda-by-K phase map now includes lif_drive_every_frame in every cell because the user explicitly required a drive_every_frame interaction test; this was omitted from the first local serialization but added before any ceiling/training run.
